AAON.headline: Aaon (AAON) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
AAON.description: Aaon reported quarterly earnings of $0.83 per share, significantly beating the consensus estimate of $0.57 and nearly doubling year-ago earnings of $0.37. Revenue also exceeded expectations at $707.43 million, up 84% year-over-year. However, the stock has declined 25% since the beginning of the year compared to the S&P 500's 7.8% gain. With a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, the stock is expected to perform in line with the market in the near term.

RKLB.headline: Rocket Lab and The Trade Desk Are 2 Beaten-Down Stocks to Buy Before 2027
RKLB.description: After significant stock declines, Rocket Lab and The Trade Desk posted Q3 results that met analyst expectations. Rocket Lab showed accelerating growth with a 52% backlog surge to $3.57B and 73% revenue growth, with its key 2027 milestone being Neutron's first launch. The Trade Desk's revenue declined but beat forecasts and maintains strong free cash flow of $565M with a low valuation at 8x FCF. Both stocks are recommended as small positions pending 2027 performance milestones.

RKLB.headline: Rocket Lab Corporation (RKLB) Reports Q3 Loss, Tops Revenue Estimates
RKLB.description: Rocket Lab Corporation (RKLB) reported a quarterly loss of $0.07 per share, significantly missing the consensus estimate of $0.02 loss, representing a -250% earnings surprise. While revenues of $267.83 million exceeded expectations by 4.42%, the company has underperformed the S&P 500 by 31.7% year-to-date. The stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

RKLB.headline: Rocket Lab Corporation (RKLB) Q3 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
RKLB.description: Rocket Lab reported Q3 2026 revenue of $267.83 million, beating consensus estimates by 4.42% with 72.7% year-over-year growth. However, the company missed on EPS, reporting -$0.07 versus an estimated -$0.02. Space Systems revenue exceeded expectations while Launch Services fell short of analyst projections. The stock has underperformed the broader market, declining 22.2% over the past month.

RKLB.headline: Breakfast News: A Boulder Amid a Rocky Market
RKLB.description: Berkshire Hathaway announced aggressive $9.6B stock buybacks in Q3 despite a 28% earnings drop, signaling management confidence in valuation. Markets faced headwinds with the S&P 500 falling 2.68% and Nasdaq dropping 3.37% last week, with tech stocks hit hardest. Several Fool-recommended companies report earnings this week including Rocket Lab, Take-Two Interactive, Cisco Systems, and others. RKLB.headline: Why Nov. 9 Could Be a Huge Day for Rocket Lab Investors
RKLB.description: Rocket Lab is set to report Q3 results on Nov. 9, 2026, which could be a major catalyst for its stock. The company's shares have declined 24% in 2026 and 64% from their all-time high due to reversed momentum in space stocks following SpaceX's IPO, defense industry valuation contractions, and political concerns. Investors will be watching for revenue exceeding guidance and gross margins at the higher end of the 35-37% target range to trigger a rebound.

IONQ.headline: IonQ Shares Surge as Revenue Soars. Is It Too Late to Buy the Quantum Computing Stock?
IONQ.description: IonQ's stock surged following Q3 earnings that significantly exceeded expectations, with revenue jumping 336% to $173.8 million. The company demonstrated strong growth in platform revenue and quantum computing systems, though it continues to burn cash. While positioned as a quantum computing leader with high-accuracy systems, analysts recommend a diversified quantum basket approach rather than single-stock betting due to competitive risks in the nascent industry.

IONQ.headline: Investors Heavily Search IonQ, Inc. (IONQ): Here is What You Need to Know
IONQ.description: IonQ (IONQ) is receiving significant investor attention but faces headwinds according to Zacks analysis. The company has a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell) rating due to significant negative revisions in earnings estimates over the past 30 days (-40.3% for fiscal year). While revenue growth is strong at +292.5% for the current fiscal year, the stock is trading at a premium valuation (F grade) and is expected to underperform the broader market in the near term.

IONQ.headline: Why IonQ Stock Plummeted 31.5% in October
IONQ.description: IonQ stock dropped 31.5% in October following the announcement of its $1.3 billion acquisition of Elisity and a $2 billion equity offering, which raised concerns about share dilution among investors. Two analysts also reduced their price targets on the stock. However, the stock has since recovered, rising over 18% in November after strong Q3 2026 earnings results.

IONQ.headline: Rigetti Pre-Q3 Earnings Analysis: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
IONQ.description: Rigetti Computing (RGTI) is expected to report Q3 2026 revenues of $3.3 million (69% YoY growth) but with doubled losses at 6 cents per share. While the company shows progress in quantum computing technology and customer engagement, elevated R&D costs, uncertain commercialization timelines, and premium valuation warrant caution. With a Zacks Rank #3 and negative Earnings ESP of -16.67%, the near-term outlook remains neutral.

IONQ.headline: IONQ Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Guidance Hike and Quantum Demand
IONQ.description: IonQ raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $505-$515M from $450-$460M, driven by 336% Q3 revenue growth to $173.83M. The company's Superion 256 capacity is fully booked for 2027 with orders extending into 2028. SkyWater integration contributed $83.5M in Q3 revenues, while IonQ Platform revenues grew 127% year-over-year. Management is focusing on manufacturing expansion, quantum security opportunities, and operational efficiency improvements.

MPWR.headline: Here's How Much a $1000 Investment in Monolithic Power Made 10 Years Ago Would Be Worth Today
MPWR.description: A $1,000 investment in Monolithic Power (MPWR) made in November 2016 would be worth $17,402.83 by November 2026, representing a 1,640.28% gain, significantly outperforming the S&P 500's 249.01% return. The semiconductor company benefits from strong demand in AI, data centers, and communications infrastructure, though it faces risks from data-center spending dependence, competition, and premium valuation.

APP.headline: Here is What to Know Beyond Why AppLovin Corporation (APP) is a Trending Stock
APP.description: AppLovin (APP) has surged 51.4% over the past month, significantly outperforming the S&P 500's -3.3% decline. The company shows strong fundamentals with earnings expected to grow 61.9% for the current fiscal year and revenue growth of 42.8%. However, with a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating and a C valuation grade indicating it trades at par with peers, the stock is expected to perform in line with the broader market in the near term.

APP.headline: APP DEADLINE: ROSEN, HIGHLY REGARDED INVESTOR RIGHTS COUNSEL, Encourages AppLovin Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important November 16 Deadline in Securities Class Action – APP
APP.description: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation for allegedly making false and misleading statements about its generative AI video creative feature, overstating AI model improvements and the benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' value proposition. Investors who purchased APP securities between February 12, 2026 and August 5, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 16, 2026.

APP.headline: Kaplan Fox Encourages Investors of AST SpaceMobile, Inc. (NASDAQ: ASTS) Who Suffered Losses to Contact the Firm Before November 13, 2026
APP.description: Kaplan Fox has filed securities class action lawsuits against AST SpaceMobile (ASTS), AppLovin (APP), and Bank of America (BAC) on behalf of investors who suffered losses. AST is accused of overstating its competitive advantages in the satellite D2C market and capital sufficiency. AppLovin's class period spans February to August 2026, and Bank of America's spans August 2025 to October 2026. Investors have until specified deadlines to seek lead plaintiff status.

APP.headline: Here is Why Growth Investors Should Buy AppLovin (APP) Now
APP.description: AppLovin (APP) is highlighted as a top growth stock pick due to its exceptional earnings growth of 61.2% (vs. 22.6% industry average), strong cash flow growth of 88.4% (vs. -2.7% industry average), and positive earnings estimate revisions. The company holds a Growth Score of B and Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), positioning it as a potential outperformer for growth investors.

FROG.headline: Why JFrog Ltd. (FROG) is a Top Momentum Stock for the Long-Term
FROG.description: Zacks Premium offers investment research tools including Style Scores (Value, Growth, Momentum, and VGM) that complement the Zacks Rank system to help investors identify stocks with the best performance potential. The article highlights JFrog Ltd. as a Stock to Watch with a #2 Buy rating and strong momentum metrics.

CIFR.headline: IREN's $4B Revenue Goal Delayed: Is the Stock Losing Its Appeal?
CIFR.description: IREN Limited has pushed its $4 billion annualized run-rate revenue goal from end-2026 to January 2027 due to design changes and supplier delays. While AI cloud revenues surged 182% to $200M, the company posted a $263M net loss with rising operating costs. IREN faces a $6B funding gap for expansion beyond its initial program, raising concerns about execution and profitability despite a substantial $20.3B revenue backlog.

OKLO.headline: AI Is Creating a Power Crisis. Constellation Energy Just Showed How It Plans to Cash In.
OKLO.description: AI's explosive growth is creating unprecedented demand for energy, with estimates suggesting the industry needs up to $7 trillion in new power generation capacity this decade. While next-gen nuclear companies like NuScale and Oklo have attracted investor interest, Constellation Energy is positioning itself as a more reliable play by expanding capacity at existing nuclear facilities and restarting Three Mile Island, rather than building new plants from scratch.

OKLO.headline: Oklo Is Down 86% From Its High. Will Shares Soar When Meta's Reactor Comes Online?
OKLO.description: Oklo, a small modular reactor (SMR) developer, has seen its stock plummet 86% from its high despite strong AI-driven demand for nuclear energy. While Meta has committed to a 1.2 GW SMR system with construction potentially starting in late 2028/early 2029, meaningful electricity generation isn't expected until 2030 at earliest. Rising capital costs, lack of NRC approval, and deteriorating AI sentiment pose significant risks to the project timeline and Oklo's financial viability.

OKLO.headline: Oklo: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
OKLO.description: Oklo outlined its strategy to build multi-reactor power fleets while commercializing fuel and isotope capabilities. Key highlights include plans to sell fuel fabrication capacity to third-party reactor operators as a standalone revenue stream, completion of Groves-1 test reactor construction in under a year, and securing component capacity for 27 Aurora reactor modules through 2035 via a long-lead supplier contract with U.S. Forged Rings.

IREN.headline: Massive News for CoreWeave, Nebius, IREN, and Applied Digital Stock Investors
IREN.description: Recent developments are causing concern among investors in AI infrastructure stocks including CoreWeave, Nebius, IREN, and Applied Digital. The article discusses how these companies are being impacted by recent market movements and investor sentiment shifts in the AI cloud and data center sector.
